name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, Michigan Wing
what_you_do: Learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Cadets lead small teams and study aerospace. They sometimes fly in CAP aircraft. They go to a week-long summer encampment.
pay_detail: Annual dues are $40 for cadets. The page estimates a fully active cadet could spend $300 to $600 in the first year, minus help for uniforms and overnight fees.
duration: Weekly 2-hour meeting, about one Saturday event a month, and one week-long summer encampment
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time through a local squadron.
how_to_apply: Find a squadron with the unit locator. Contact it to confirm a meeting. Go to about three meetings before you finish the membership application.
notes: Volunteer youth program, not a job. Wing HQ mailing address: 43401 N. Jefferson, Bldg. 825, Rm 317, PO Box 450048, Selfridge ANGB, MI 48045-0048. School comes first; the page says school-based squadrons may differ.
